name: The era transition stands — reconciliation made testable
reason: J-01 is tagged '(Keyless; automated.)' in docs/goal.md — its Acceptance is entirely pytest-fixture-based ('on the fixture rig ... hand-computed fixture numbers exact'; suite green; fingerprint pin unchanged). Its only observable runtime surface is GET /research/desk/referee/evidence on the BACKEND origin (:8301). There is no frontend page, nav entry, or proxy for it: apps/frontend/next.config.js declares zero rewrites, `grep -rli referee apps/frontend/` returns zero matches anywhere in frontend source, and curling the identical path on the frontend origin (:3301) 404s. demo_runner.py's normalize_url (scripts/automation/lib/demo_runner.py:39-57) unconditionally rewrites any localhost/127.0.0.1 absolute goto URL onto base_url's own host:port before navigating — so a goto step aimed at the backend origin would silently redirect to the frontend port and 404 on EVERY future replay: a permanent, deterministic false-FAIL trap, not a flaky one. This is a structural limitation of the runner's single-base-url model (confirmed by reading the source, not assumed), not a transient authoring gap — it will not resolve itself as code is added elsewhere. It can only change if (a) the runner gains a second declared origin for backend-only journeys, or (b) a later journey (J-07/J-09) lands a real /desk UI surface that itself renders referee data — at which point THAT journey earns the golden, not this one. Marked not_yet so replay_lane_golden_coverage's file-existence gap check (scripts/automation/lib/replay-lane.sh:522-541) stops re-nudging this permanently-backend-only journey every iteration; run_verify (demo_runner.py:1146) treats not_yet as a safe SKIP, never a false FAIL. Verified instead via real browser navigation to the live endpoint each iteration (see reports/phase-goal-referee-iter-1-ui-test-results.llm.md and reports/phase-goal-referee-iter-2-ui-test-results.llm.md, UT-J-01).
